name: AI Retargeting Connector
description: Provisions every custom field and tag the AI Retargeting Callback app expects to exist in a GHL sub-account. Idempotent — the provisioner only creates what isn't already there.
_notes: This file is the source of truth for first-time GHL setup. lib/ghl/setup.ts reads it; the /config dashboard's 'Provision custom fields + tags' button runs that setup. Keep this file in sync with lib/state.ts — anything state.ts reads or writes must be declared here.

customFields.name: AI Step Index
customFields.description: Current 0-indexed cadence step the lead is on.

customFields.name: AI Next Attempt At
customFields.description: ISO timestamp the next cadence step is due to fire.

customFields.name: AI Last Outcome
customFields.description: answered | no_answer | voicemail | busy | failed | sms_sent | email_sent | sms_reply | email_unsubscribed | ...

customFields.name: AI Transcript URL
customFields.description: URL of the most recent call transcript from Retell.

customFields.name: AI Active Call ID
customFields.description: Set to the Retell call_id while a call is in flight; cleared on call end.

customFields.name: AI SMS Consent
customFields.description: Currently not enforced (FB Lead Form captures consent upstream).

customFields.name: AI Email Consent
customFields.description: Currently not enforced (FB Lead Form captures consent upstream).

tags.name: ai-callback
tags.description: Adding this tag enters the contact into the cadence. The intake pass removes it once the lead is processed.

tags.name: ai-active
tags.description: Added by intake. Marks contacts currently moving through the cadence. Used by the dispatch pass to find due leads.

tags.name: ai-engaged
tags.description: Set on terminal engagement (lead picked up + stayed past threshold, OR replied via SMS, OR called back inbound).

tags.name: ai-exhausted
tags.description: Set on terminal exhaustion (max attempts reached without engagement).

tags.name: stop-ai-callback
tags.description: Adding this tag cancels all remaining cadence steps for the contact.

installer.checkboxNotes: GHL's CHECKBOX dataType requires an options array (it's a multi-select checkbox under the hood, not a boolean). The provisioner passes options: ["Yes"] so a ticked box stores the string "Yes", which the app's toBool() helper accepts.
